name: CSR (relative-only)
_comment: CSR is a relative-only protocol: R%.0f,%.0f moves without cutting and I%.0f,%.0f cuts while moving. Some vendor documentation annotates these as MC=R.../r/l and LC=I.../r/l, where /r/l means relative/line and is an annotation, not part of the bytes sent. The protocol declares no header, no footer, and no force/speed/up-speed commands. Every coordinate is a delta from the carriage's current position, so the emitter tracks position across the whole job. Because there is no explicit pen-up word, a zero-length R0,0; is sent as a safety lift when a job ends on a draw.
_tool_comment: CSR drives drag-knife cutters. 0.25 mm suits a 45 degree blade; a pen or crease tool wants 0.
